issue_context.title: Column information in error message is missing.
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

1. What did you do?
If possible, provide a recipe for reproducing the error.


```mysql
SELECT  `col_float_signed` AS field1  FROM `table50_int_autoinc` GROUP BY GET_FORMAT( DATETIME, 'ISO' );
```

2. What did you expect to see?

```
ERROR 1055 (42000): Expression #1 of SELECT list is not in GROUP BY clause and contains nonaggregated column 'randgen_test.table50_int_autoinc.col_float_signed' which is not functionally dependent on columns in GROUP BY clause; this is incompatible with sql_mode=only_full_group_by
```

3. What did you see instead?

The column information is missing.
```
ERROR 1055 (42000): Expression #1 of SELECT list is not in GROUP BY clause and contains nonaggregated column '' which is not functionally dependent on columns in GROUP BY clause; this is incompatible with sql_mode=only_full_group_by
```

4. What version of TiDB are you using (`tidb-server -V` or run `select tidb_version();` on TiDB)?

review_comments: Add a case that the table is aliased twice and column is aliased twice too.

do you mean a sql like:
```
create table t (a int, b int, c int);
seleselect bAlias as bAlias2 from (select a as aAlias, b as bAlias from t as tableAlias) as tableAlias2 group by tableAlias2.aAlias;
```

but I found the tidb didn't show an error. but mysql will show an error.
```
mysql> select bAlias as bAlias2 from (select a as aAlias, b as bAlias from t as tableAlias) as tableAlias2 group by tableAlias2.aAlias;
ERROR 1055 (42000): Expression #1 of SELECT list is not in GROUP BY clause and contains nonaggregated column 'tableAlias2.bAlias' which is not functionally dependent on columns in GROUP BY clause; this is incompatible with sql_mode=only_full_group_by
mysql> select @@version;
+-----------+
| @@version |
+-----------+
| 5.7.26    |
+-----------+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)
```
This is a bug I think we can track it in another issue -https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/11437
